primary_work.title: Causal Abstraction Inference under Lossy Representations
primary_work.code_status: no paper-specific immutable author-maintained reproduction repository verified from the primary records or targeted search

decision: NARROWED BEYOND LOSSY PROJECTED CAUSAL ABSTRACTIONS — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: many-to-one low-level intervention mappings are inherently invalid causal abstractions
language is required merely because a causal representation is lossy
accurate high-level observational, interventional, or counterfactual queries prove fine-grained target-partition recovery
a human-readable high-level intervention label resolves the low-level intervention identity inside an abstraction fibre
task success or high-level next-state prediction demonstrates joint identification of raw utterance equivalence and latent targets
remaining_rq: After constructing the strongest valid projected abstraction and identifying all supported high-level queries, can a preregistered externally fixed language law distinguish fine-grained target partitions inside a lossy abstraction fibre, jointly identify the corresponding raw-utterance equivalence, and eliminate every fibre-preserving joint recoding?
